Dear Yunus Emre Temel,
Thank you for reaching
out

Vikas

Product
: Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset

Y2 / R6 313065117062
Charger ID/Serial No.
:
RbirXn
Problem Description
:
Power Converters error E34
Troubleshooting
:
1. Check for any loose connection of any power cable or CAN communication cables of the converter and measured the voltage across it with the help of multimeter. Check the resistance across CAN communication cables.
2. Please see to the display of the power converter whether it is OFF state or ON?
3. Try swapping the power converter
2102312VGQKXP1000772SA042200000204FW:DC117PF117H100
with the good one and if the error flag was changed to the replaced one then we can suspect that the converter is faulty.
4. If all the steps are performed and you still see the power converter are faulty, we suggest you replace it as we can't rework to it.
Please ensure the electrical safety and follow the PPE guidelines
Here are the part order code details for ordering the power converter
Order Code: 8EM5903-0AA01-0AA2 also you can know more about spare parts here:
SICHARGE D HW rev. 0 Spare Part List - ID: 109814736 - Industry Support Siemens
For future reference, your case number is
0399298
, please do refer to this in all further communication regarding this issue.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
With best regards,

Vikas Khiladkar
